# hubspot_product (Resource)

Manages one standard HubSpot Product definition by its generated `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hubspot_product" "support" {
  name                     = "Annual support"
  sku                      = "support-annual"
  description              = "Priority support for one year"
  price                    = "1200.00"
  cost                     = "300.00"
  recurring_billing_period = "P12M"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Product description.
- `name` (String) Product name; it is managed presentation, not identity.
- `price` (String) Exact non-negative Product price decimal string.
- `sku` (String) Product SKU mapped to hs_sku; the generated ID remains identity.

### Optional

- `cost` (String) Optional exact cost decimal string. `null` is unmanaged and an empty string clears `hs_cost_of_goods_sold`.
- `recurring_billing_period` (String) Optional positive whole-month recurrence in `P#M` form. `null` is unmanaged and an empty string clears it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) HubSpot-generated numeric Product `id` and sole state and import identity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hubspot_product.support 123456789
```
